info.name: RE/MAX EU - Listings API - Staging
info.description:
The Listings API is used in conjunction with the RE/MAX EU Datahub application to add, update and get listing data.

Users can interact with the API using REST (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) requests to the API URL.

OAuth 2.0 Authentication

The user makes a request for an API token using the OAuth 2.0 server. The access_key is then added as the access_token query parameter.

Data Return Format

In general, all requests have the following reponse format:

{
  "success": false | true,
  "message": <Descriptive message>,
  "result": {},// any data is returned here
  "error": { // if success is false, an error will be returned here
    "error": "Invalid region action requested: the user does not have access to this region"
  },
  "status": { 
    "code": 403, // http response code
    "message": "Forbidden" // http response message
  }
}

The only exceptions are:

  • get listings

  • get listing detail

  • get listing countries

  • get listing cities by country

request.description:
This request is used to add listings to the Listings API. The API uses a queueing system, and some validation is done in the queue. If the validation fails (on agent for example), the record is still added to the database, but a flag is set to indicate some validation has failed.

The body, as per the sample below, contain certain required fields:

"listingId" : "test-123", // unique identifier for listing (required)
"status": "Active",   // can be 'Inactive', 'Active', 'Expired', 'Sold', 'Sale Agreed', 'Cancelled' (required)
"agentUniqueId": "AT-P100009", // this is the unique agent Id from Datahub (required)
"title": "Sample Title 2", // text title 
"description": "Sample Description 2", // text description (required)
"roomDescription" : "Sample room description", // text (optional)
"bedroomDescription" : "Sample bedroom description", // text (optional)
"bathroomDesctiption" : "Sample bathroom description", // text (optional)
"kitchenDescription" : "Sample kitchen description", // text (optional)
"address": "1234 Sample Street", // address required
"streetBlock": "Block 4", // street block (optional)
"zipcode": "12345", // zipcode (required)
"regionId": "AT1", // datahub regionId (required)
"officeId":"AT1-F1079993", // datahub officeId (required)
"city": "Vienna2", // city name (required)
"country": "Austria", // country name (required)
"offerType": "Sale", // can be 'Sale' or 'Rental' (required)
"listingType": "Commercial", // can be 'Commercial' or 'Residential'
"propertyType" : "Villa" , // text field (optional)
// either buildingSize or propertySize must be passed, but both can also be passed
"buildingSize": 1000.00,  // number, building size (optional)
"propertySize": 2000.00,  // number, property size (optional)
"sizeUnit": "m2",    // size unit of buildingSize and propertySize (required)
"virtualTour": "No", // string value (required)
"noOfRooms": 5, // number (optoonal)
"noOfBathrooms": 2, // number (optional)
"noOfBedrooms" : 3, // number (optional)
"constructionYear": 2000, // construction year (required)
"energyRating": "A", // energy rating (required)
"floorNumber": "1",  // floor number, (required)
"elevatorAccess": "Yes", // string value (optional, can also be null, or left out)
"outsideAreaType": "Garden", // optional 
"outsideAreaSize": "Large", // optional
"listingPrice": 1000000.00, // number value (required)
"listingCurrency":  "eur", // Currency ISO
"sellPrice": 950000.00, // sell price (optional)
"dateSold": "2022-01-01T00:00:00Z", // optional value
"datePublished": "2022-01-01T00:00:00Z", // required
"listingUrl" : "https://listing.com/1234", // required
"commissionRateBuyer": 3.00, // optional
"commissionRateSeller": 3.00, // optional
"contractType": "Open", // can be 'Open', 'Exclusive', 'Excluded for Cooperation' (required)
"buyerDemographic": "80+", // can be '18 - 35', '36 - 50', '51 - 65', '66 - 80', '80+' (optional)
"sellerDemographic": "80+", // can be '18 - 35', '36 - 50', '51 - 65', '66 - 80', '80+' (optional)
"listingImages" : [ //images are optional
  {
    "webLink" : "test.image1.com", // this is required if image is passed
    "description" : "Bathroom 1" // this is required if image is passed
    "isPrimary": true // this will use the image as the cover image for the listing
  },
  {
     "webLink" : "test.image2.com", // this is required if image is passed
     "description" : "Bathroom 2" // this is required if image is passed
     "isPrimary": false
   }
],
"agentImage" : 
 {
    "webLink" : "test.image1.com",
    "description" : "Agent Image Test",
    "isPrimary" : true
 }

The listing will be added to the queuing system: three parameters are passed that cannot be validated asynchronously:

  • agentId

  • regionId

  • officeId

The application searches for a valid agent, region and office using the passed values. If an agent, region or office cannot be found in the RE/MAX EU Datahub database, a 'null' value is saved for agent, region or office and the appropriate flag is set: agentMatched is set if the agent is found, officeMatched is set if the office is found, regionMatched is set if the region is found.

"description": "Sample Description 2", // text description (required)

"bedroomDescription" : "Sample bedroom description", // text (optional)

"kitchenDescription" : "Sample kitchen description", // text (optional)

"streetBlock": "Block 4", // street block (optional)
"zipcode": "12345", // zipcode (required)
"regionId": "AT1", // datahub regionId (required)
"officeId":"AT1-F1079993", // datahub officeId (required)

"offerType": "Sale", // can be 'Sale' or 'Rental' (required)

// either buildingSize or propertySize must be passed, but both can also be passed
"buildingSize": 1000.00,  // number, building size (optional)
"propertySize": 2000.00,  // number, property size (optional)
"sizeUnit": "m2",    // size unit of buildingSize and propertySize (required)
"virtualTour": "No", // string value (required)
"noOfRooms": 5, // number (optoonal)
"noOfBathrooms": 2, // number (optional)
"noOfBedrooms" : 3, // number (optional)

"sellerDemographic": "80+", // can be '18 - 35', '36 - 50', '51 - 65', '66 - 80', '80+' (optional)

"agentImage" : 
 {
    "webLink" : "test.image1.com",

This request is used to delete a listing in the Listings API using the Id of the listing as route parameter.
This request is used to delete a listing in the Listings API using the Id of the listing as route parameter.

This request returns all active listings (where isDeleted is false),

Search Parameters

The following search parameters can be passed to filter listings:

  • country - string value i.e. Austria, also searches for partial matches

  • city - string value i.e. Vienna, also searches for partial matches

  • offerType - 'Sale' or 'Rental'

  • listingType - 'Commercial' or 'Residential'

  • sizeMin - filters on propertySize larger or equal to sizeMin

  • sizeMax- filters on propertySize smaller or equal to sizeMax

  • priceMin - filters on listingPrice larger or equal to priceMin

  • priceMax - filters on listingPrice smaller or equal to priceMax

  • status - filters on listing status 1 (Active), 2 (Expired), 3 (Sold), 4 (Sale Agreed), 5 (Cancelled), 6 (Inactive)

The return object will look as follows:

[
    {
        "id": 1,
        "title": "Sample Title 1",
        "description": "Sample Description 1",
        "address": "1234 Sample Street",
        ...
    },
    {
        "id": 2,
        "title": "Sample Title 2",
        "description": "Sample Description 2",
        "address": "1234 Sample Street",
        ...
    }
]

description.content: Accepts a comma seperated list of values to do a strict search on, for example if the value is balcony, garden, it will search where outsideAreaType has balcony and garden

Accepts two values: true or false, if true, the API returns all listings where the elevatorAccess value is not null or empty. If false, the API returns all listings where the elevatorAccess is null or empty
Accepts single or combination of values: 1 (Active), 2 (Expired), 3 (Sold), 4 (Sale Agreed), 5 (Cancelled), 6 (Inactive)
